title: Export UBC Workday Excel for this timetable maker.
lead: The UBC schedule maker needs the Excel Workday gives you from View My Courses — not a screenshot and not a PDF.
step1b: Sign in, then open View My Courses.
step2b: Under the “View My Courses” title, click the first icon — the one to the left of the PDF icon. Keep the .xlsx or .xls file.
step3b: Open Schedule Maker and use Import Excel. Columns are read by header name: Course Listing, Section, Registration Status, Meeting Patterns, Instructor, and dates.
step4: Choose what goes on the grid
step4b: Nothing is placed automatically. Check Active courses, add Waitlist as dashed boxes, and leave Dropped off unless you need them.
note: Labs with a blank meeting pattern stay in the list so you can add a time. Need the UBC-specific overview? Open the UBC timetable maker page.
seoTitle: UBC Workday Excel to Timetable | Timetable Craft
seoDescription: Export UBC Workday View My Courses Excel and open it in this timetable maker. Parse locally, pick classes, and build your weekly schedule.
